wa_privacy_title: Easytrade Müşavirim Ofis · WhatsApp extension privacy notice
wa_privacy_intro: This extension lets accounting office users save receipts, invoices and documents sent to them on WhatsApp Web to their office's Easytrade Müşavirim Ofis account. This page explains what the extension accesses, what it sends where, and what it stores in the browser.
wa_privacy_where_1: It runs only on web.whatsapp.com. It adds no buttons to other sites and does not read their content.
wa_privacy_where_2: It talks only to your office's Easytrade Müşavirim Ofis server over an encrypted (https) connection. Access to that server is requested during pairing, not at install, and only for that address.
wa_privacy_sent_title: What is sent to your office's server
wa_privacy_sent_1: When pairing: the one-time code from the panel and, if you enter one, a computer name. No password is asked.
wa_privacy_sent_2: When you press a save button: only that single file (image or PDF), its file name and the record type you chose (expense, income, document or foreign invoice).
wa_privacy_sent_3: To link the chat to a taxpayer: the active chat's identifier (in a one-to-one chat the other person's phone number, in a group the group identifier) and the chat name.
wa_privacy_sent_4: When choosing a taxpayer: the name or tax number you type in the search box; when saving a document: the document request you choose.
wa_privacy_sent_5: Read requests for the office summary: Inbox counts, recent VAT alerts and taxpayers with open document requests. These send no data; they read your office's records within your permissions.
wa_privacy_sent_6: The session information issued by the server, to keep the session alive or to close it.
wa_privacy_not_read_title: What is not read or sent
wa_privacy_not_read_1: Message texts are not read or sent.
wa_privacy_not_read_2: Files you did not click, other chats, your contact list and your profile are not sent.
wa_privacy_not_read_3: PDF capture stays on for only 20 seconds after you press a button and takes a single download; your own downloads are not touched.
wa_privacy_not_read_4: Your browsing history and activity on other sites are not tracked.
wa_privacy_not_read_5: There are no advertising or analytics tools. The extension sends data nowhere except your office's server.
wa_privacy_stored_title: What is stored in your browser
wa_privacy_stored_1: The office server address and the information used to renew the session are stored in this browser profile.
wa_privacy_stored_2: The short-lived access information and the office summary (at most 5 minutes old) are deleted when the browser closes.
wa_privacy_stored_3: If you entered a panel address yourself, that address is stored.
wa_privacy_stored_4: Files, messages and contacts are not stored in the browser.
wa_privacy_server_title: Where the sent data is processed
wa_privacy_server_1: Files and chat links are kept in your office's Easytrade Müşavirim Ofis account. Your office is the data controller for taxpayer data.
wa_privacy_server_2: Receipts saved as expense or income are read automatically on the server and become drafts awaiting approval; an office user approves them.
wa_privacy_server_3: Who saved which file is recorded in the office's records.
wa_privacy_control_1: The "Bağlantıyı kes" (Disconnect) button in the extension window also closes the session on the server and deletes the session information in the browser.
wa_privacy_control_2: You can also close the session in the panel under Account → Sessions.
wa_privacy_control_3: Removing the extension from the browser deletes everything it stored in the browser.
wa_privacy_limited_use: Data used by the extension is used only for the purpose described on this page, in line with the Chrome Web Store User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements; it is not sold or transferred to third parties.
